description: Replication Data for: The Road More Traveled: Evacuation Networks from 10 disasters in the US and Japan is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Timothy Fraser (Northeastern University). When crisis strikes, where do evacuees go? This question greatly affects how policymakers and first responders should allocate their time, funds, and resources after disaster. While past research compared evacuation rates of cities within the same disaster, evacuation rates among different types of disasters remains under-examined. Coverage: national (JP); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 482116206. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
